xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3968: pan close still deletes state.json/sessions.json — close-out.ts step 5 never moved to pruneAgentStateDir (PAN-3950 AC-1 unmet)

plan.title: pan close still deletes state.json/sessions.json — the live deleter is the close-out:prune-agent-rows step in lifecycle/workflows.ts (PAN-3950 AC-1 unmet)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5

narratives.Problem: After `pan close`, `~/.overdeck/agents/agent-<id>/` loses `state.json` and `sessions.json`, so the agent transcript route returns `No transcript found` even though the Claude JSONL still exists. The issue blames `src/lib/close-out.ts` step 5, but that function (`executeCloseOut`) has no production caller. The live ceremony is `closeOut()` in `src/lib/lifecycle/workflows.ts`: its teardown step already prunes correctly with `pruneAgentStateDir` and prints 'transcripts and state kept', and then the later `close-out:prune-agent-rows` step (`workflows.ts:384-389`) calls `pruneStoppedAgentsForIssue` → `pruneAgentRowsAfterTranscriptCleanup` → `removeAgentStateDir`, which unlinks every non-.jsonl file and writes the `.retained-transcripts` marker found on `agent-pan-3950` at the close-out timestamp. PR #3951 never touched `workflows.ts` or `agent-gc.ts`.
narratives.Proposal: Delete the `close-out:prune-agent-rows` block and its `agent-gc` import from `workflows.ts` (teardown already ran the correct prune on the same directories), with a regression test that runs the real `closeOut()` against a fixture under `getOverdeckHome()/agents/` and asserts `state.json`/`sessions.json` survive. Delete the now-callerless `pruneStoppedAgentsForIssue` and its test. Delete the dead `executeCloseOut` ceremony from `close-out.ts` (keeping `isBranchMerged`) together with its test file, which satisfies the issue's literal `grep removeAgentStateDir src/lib/close-out.ts` acceptance line and removes the second-ceremony trap. Add one docs sentence to `docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md` naming the only paths that still delete `state.json`. Full detail with before/after snippets in `.pan/drafts/PAN-3968.md`.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to `pan admin db gc-agents` / `pruneTerminalStoppedAgents`: it stays destructive (docs already say GC is a destructive path); hazard H-3 in the PRD.
- No change to deep-wipe (`agents/agent-state.ts:86`), legacy-row drop (`agents/queries.ts:131`), or `removeAgent` (`agents/removal.ts:22`) — intentional wipes.
- No change to `state-dir-removal.ts` or `teardown-workspace.ts`; they are already correct after PR #3951.
- No backfill code or command for the already-pruned `agent-pan-3705` / `agent-pan-3950` directories; PRD Appendix A gives the operator-only recipe and the work agent must not run it.
- No migration of `executeCloseOut` step 5 to `pruneAgentStateDir` — the function is deleted instead (fallback only if a production importer is found, PRD D-2).
- No new module, store, flag, config, or polling.

autoDecisions.summary: Corrected the root cause: the live deleter is `close-out:prune-agent-rows` in `src/lib/lifecycle/workflows.ts:384-389`, not `close-out.ts` step 5, which is dead code.
autoDecisions.rationale: `executeCloseOut` is imported only by its own test; `pan close` and the dashboard route both call `lifecycle/workflows.ts closeOut()`. The `.retained-transcripts` marker on `agent-pan-3950` at the close-out timestamp is written only by `pruneAgentRowsAfterTranscriptCleanup`/`removeAgent`, and PR #3951's stat shows it never touched `workflows.ts` or `agent-gc.ts`. Both the issue and the PAN-3950 PRD want state kept, so this is a correction, not a contradiction.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix by deleting the GC step rather than re-pointing it at `pruneAgentStateDir`.
autoDecisions.rationale: Teardown already ran `pruneAgentStateDir` on the same directories two steps earlier; a second prune is a no-op that keeps a second cleanup path alive, which is the exact shape of bug this issue reports.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete the dead `executeCloseOut` ceremony and its test instead of migrating its step 5.
autoDecisions.rationale: Migrating dead code satisfies the grep AC while preserving the trap; deletion satisfies the same AC, removes ~440 lines, and honours PAN-3950 NFR-1 (net negative). Fallback recorded in PRD D-2 if a production importer turns up.

autoDecisions.summary: Already-pruned directories (`agent-pan-3705`, `agent-pan-3950`) are an operator one-off, not code in this issue or PAN-3959.
autoDecisions.rationale: Recovery needs a hand-written `state.json` (for the workspace slug, since the worktree is gone) plus `sessions.json`; two directories do not justify a tool. PRD Appendix A holds the exact recipe.

autoDecisions.summary: `pan admin db gc-agents` keeps its destructive `removeAgentStateDir` behaviour.
autoDecisions.rationale: docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md already names garbage collection as a destructive path; changing it is a separate decision (hazard H-3).

autoDecisions.summary: Regression test seeds the fixture under `getOverdeckHome()/agents/`, not the mocked `AGENTS_DIR`.
autoDecisions.rationale: `workflows.test.ts` mocks `paths.js` `AGENTS_DIR` to one temp root while `listAgentStatesSync`/`saveAgentStateSync` resolve `getOverdeckHome()`; the deleted GC step deleted under the latter, so a fixture under the mocked root would pass before the fix and prove nothing.

items.title: Remove the close-out:prune-agent-rows step from closeOut() with a regression test

expected_outputs: tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/workflows.test.ts passes including the new test 'keeps state.json and sessions.json of the issue's agents (PAN-3968)'

narrative.Action: PRD W1. In `src/lib/lifecycle/workflows.ts` delete line 35 (`import { pruneStoppedAgentsForIssue } from '../cloister/agent-gc.js';`) and the block at lines 384-389 (grep anchor `close-out:prune-agent-rows`: `const pruned = yield* Effect.promise(() => pruneStoppedAgentsForIssue(ctx.issueId));` through the `stepOk('close-out:prune-agent-rows', ...)` push). Keep the `close-out:ack-parked-residue` step that follows so it still runs after `close-out:mark-pipeline-terminal`. Then add to `tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/workflows.test.ts` inside `describe('closeOut', ...)` a test named `keeps state.json and sessions.json of the issue's agents (PAN-3968)`: seed `join(getOverdeckHome(), 'agents', 'agent-pan-100')` (import `getOverdeckHome` from `../../../../src/lib/paths.js`; NOT the mocked `AGENTS_DIR`, see PRD D-5) with `state.json` (`{ id: 'agent-pan-100', issueId: 'PAN-100', role: 'work', status: 'running', workspace: '/repo/workspaces/feature-pan-100', harness: 'claude-code', model: 'claude', startedAt: '2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z' }`), `sessions.json` (one JSON line `{"sessionId":"session-1","at":"2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z","source":"hook","harness":"claude-code","model":"claude"}`), `activity.jsonl`, and `pending.lock`; call `writeSpecForIssue(testDir, makeXBrief('PAN-100'), 'active')` then `closeOut({ issueId: 'PAN-100', projectPath: testDir }, { tracker: successfulTracker() })` exactly like the neighbouring 'should complete xBRIEF status and prune checkpoint refs during close-out' test; assert success, that `state.json`, `sessions.json`, `activity.jsonl` still exist, that `.retained-transcripts` does not exist, that `state.json.status === 'stopped'`, and that no step is named `close-out:prune-agent-rows`; remove the fixture dir in a `finally`. Implementation checkpoint: run the new test before deleting the workflows.ts block and confirm it fails on the `state.json` assertion; if it passes unfixed, the fixture is under the wrong root — fix the path before proceeding. Do not assert `pending.lock` removal here (teardown prunes under the mocked `AGENTS_DIR`; `state-dir-removal.test.ts` covers it). Commit scope `cloister`, trailer `Item: remove-close-out-row-gc`.

If a production importer exists, STOP and apply the D-2 fallback instead (replace the two `removeAgentStateDir(...)` calls at `close-out.ts:432,437` with `pruneAgentStateDir(...)`, drop the `preservedTranscripts` count, set the step message to `Agent state directories pruned (transcripts and state kept)`, and name the importer in the PR body). Otherwise: in `src/lib/close-out.ts` delete lines 201 through 628 (from `export interface CloseOutStep {` to the end of file — note line 224 fuses `const CLOSED_OUT_COLOR = '1d4ed8';` and `async function executeCloseOutPromise(` on one line, so delete the whole line), replace the file header comment (lines 1-6) with one describing `isBranchMerged` as merge detection for close-out and residue reaping and pointing at `lifecycle/workflows.ts closeOut()` for the ceremony, and reduce the imports (lines 8-28) to `import { exec } from 'child_process';` and `import { promisify } from 'util';` (nothing in lines 30-199 uses fs, path, os, effect, ./paths.js, ./prd-locations.js, ./tmux.js, ./lifecycle/types.js, ./lifecycle/close-issue.js, ./lifecycle/archive-planning.js, ./workspace-manager/docker.js, ./issue-id.js, or ./agents/state-dir-removal.js). Keep `execAsync`, `ARTIFACT_PATH_PREFIXES`, `ARTIFACT_EXCLUSIONS`, `isSquashMergedViaPr`, and `isBranchMerged` byte-for-byte. Delete `src/lib/__tests__/close-out.test.ts` (it imports only `executeCloseOut`). `src/lib/cloister/__tests__/reap-issue-residue.test.ts` mocks `isBranchMerged` and needs no change.
